What you can do inside the builder, in detail.

DESIGN

Design both devices

Switch the preview between Desktop and Mobile and design each one separately — layout, headline size, spacing and columns. Or click anything in the big preview and edit its text, font, colour, image and button style right there.

ADS

Add ads from any network

Adsterra, Google AdSense, PropellerAds, Monetag or any other network — paste each code into its own slot: popunder, top banner, in-content, native, social bar and sticky footer.

PUBLISH

Publish & host here

One click in the Publish tab puts your page live on this PageCraft domain at your own page address. Templates stay on PageCraft — they are hosted, never downloaded.

Free & Pro: Templates marked Free are fully usable. Templates marked Pro open in the builder so you can design with them; hosted Pro pages keep a small "Made with PageCraft" line in this free version. Templates cannot be downloaded — every page is hosted on this domain instead.

Editing needs Desktop Mode on mobile

মোবাইলে এডিটর ঠিকভাবে দেখা যায় না — তাই Desktop Mode অন না করলে এডিটিং চালু হবে না।

The builder is designed for a wide desktop layout. On a phone screen the panels and preview get squeezed and hard to use, so editing stays locked until Desktop Mode is on. Turn it on and this page will switch to the full desktop layout — then every editing tool works exactly as it does on a computer. Nothing is locked on a desktop device.


Desktop Mode ON — full desktop layout, editing is enabled. Pinch to zoom if text looks small.

Features on your page — all changeable

These 5 highlights appear on your page. Edit any title or line, change its icon, add more, or delete one — the preview updates instantly. You can also click a feature card in the preview.

Tip: You can also click any text, image or button directly in the big preview to edit it there — font, size, colour and style included.

A preset changes colour, font, background and button shape together. Fine-tune anything afterwards — every setting stays editable.

Separate device design

Desktop and mobile are designed separately. Switch the preview device (top-right of the preview) and adjust each version — visitors automatically see the design made for their device.

Build your page block by block — this is how a Blank Page is made. Blocks appear below your hero section in order. You can also click a block in the preview to edit it.

Not just Adsterra — paste ad codes from any network: Adsterra, Google AdSense, PropellerAds, Monetag or any other. Pick the network for each slot, paste its code exactly as the network gives it, and it runs in that slot on your live page.

How to set up ads correctly — 4 steps

  1. Create the ad unit in your network dashboard first (Adsterra: Websites → your site → Add Ad Unit. AdSense: Ads → By ad unit. PropellerAds / Monetag: Sites → Zones).
  2. Match the format to the right slot below — use the slot map. A code in the wrong slot will not show properly.
  3. Copy the FULL code — every <script> tag, exactly as given. Do not shorten it, do not paste only a link.
  4. Publish, then open the live page to test. Real ads never load inside the builder preview — that protects your account from invalid self-impressions. They load on the published live page.
Popunder / PopAdsterra Popunder · PropellerAds OnClick · Monetag OnClick
Top BannerAdsterra Banner 728×90 or 320×50 · AdSense Display unit
In-Content BannerAdsterra Banner 300×250 / 728×90 · AdSense In-article
Native AdsAdsterra Native Banner · Monetag Native · AdSense Multiplex
Social BarAdsterra Social Bar · PropellerAds In-Page Push · Monetag Push
Sticky FooterAdsterra Banner 320×50 · AdSense Anchor-style unit

One network code per slot. Never paste the same code into two slots, and never click your own ads. New Adsterra / AdSense units can take 5–30 minutes to start filling after the first live view.
